meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化浏览器交互，用于网页测试、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来测试网页或提取数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for web testing, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or scraping

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行控制浏览器，执行打开网页、点击、填写表单、截图、提取数据、管理 Cookie 和 LocalStorage、录制视频等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要导航网站、填表、截图、测试 Web 应用或提取网页信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我自动填写登录表单并提交
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器，填入信息并提交表单。

say.text: 打开百度搜索'天气'，截图保存
say.note: Claude 会导航到百度，搜索关键词并截图。

say.text: 模拟鼠标移动到左上角并点击
say.note: Claude 会移动鼠标并点击指定位置。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can control a browser via the command line to perform actions like opening pages, clicking, filling forms, taking screenshots, extracting data, managing cookies and localStorage, and recording videos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, test web apps, or extract information from web pages.

say_en.text: Automatically fill and submit the login form for me.
say_en.note: Claude will open a browser, fill in credentials, and submit.

say_en.text: Open Baidu, search 'weather', and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will navigate to Baidu, perform search, and capture screenshot.

say_en.text: Simulate mouse movement to top-left and click.
say_en.note: Claude will move the mouse and click at that position.
